historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of an existing one-story plus basement single-family dwelling.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the construction of a new three-story, two-family residential structure with modifications to the garage, bathroom, windows and materials.
An existing one-story plus basement single-family dwelling stood at the property.
